title: Refresh an MCP access token
content_data:
Use this endpoint to exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token. You need to call this before your current access token expires, using the same token endpoint you used for the authorization code exchange. # Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/{server}/oauth/token/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | Content-Type {Required} | string | Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. | ``` **Path parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |server {Required}|string|The specific TikTok for Business MCP server URL.

Enum values: `tt-ads-mcp-flat`, `tt-ads-mcp-layer`.

To learn more about how these server URLs differ, see [Choose your server URL](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-a-custom-agent-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3#anchor-3).| ``` **Body parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |grant_type {Required}|string|The method for granting tokens.

Enum value:
  • `refresh_token`: To exchange your refresh token for a new access token.
| |refresh_token {Required}|string|The refresh token that was issued to you [when you obtained the access token](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/exchange-an-mcp-authorization-code-for-tokens/v1.3).| ``` ## Example > **Note**
> The example below uses `tt-ads-mcp-layer` as the `{server}` value. You can replace this with your chosen server value. ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer/oauth/token' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \ --data-urlencode 'grant_type=refresh_token' \ --data-urlencode 'refresh_token={{refresh_token}}' (/code) ``` # Response A successful refresh returns HTTP `200 OK`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |access_token|string|The new access token issued to you.| |refresh_token|string|The refresh token issued to you for future token renewals.| |token_type|string|The type of token issued.

Enum value:
  • `bearer`: Bearer token, an OAuth 2.0 access token where possession of the token itself is sufficient for access.
| |expires_in|integer|The remaining validity period of the access token, expressed in seconds.| |refresh_token_expires_in|integer|The remaining validity period of the refresh token, expressed in seconds.| |scope|string|The specific permission scope granted to your token.

Enum value:
  • `mcp:tt4b`: the necessary permissions to access TikTok for Business MCP server features.
| ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "access_token": "{{access_token}}", "expires_in": 86399, "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}", "refresh_token_expires_in": 2591941, "scope": "mcp:tt4b", "token_type": "bearer" } (/code) ``` ## Error response A failure returns HTTP `400 Bad Request`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | error | string | Error code.
To learn about the possible errors and descriptions, see [List of possible errors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/refresh-an-mcp-access-token/v1.3#anchor-2-2-1). | | error_description | string | The human-readable description of the error.
To learn about the possible errors and descriptions, see [List of possible errors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/refresh-an-mcp-access-token/v1.3#anchor-2-2-1). | ``` ### List of possible errors ```xtable |error{50%}|error_description{50%}| |---|---| |`invalid_request`|`grant_type is required`| |`invalid_request`|`refresh_token is required`| |`unsupported_grant_type`|`grant_type is not supported`| |`invalid_grant`|`refresh token not found`| |`invalid_grant`|`refresh token revoked`| |`invalid_grant`|`refresh token expired`| |`invalid_grant`|`refresh token is bound to a different MCP server`| ```
seo_title: Refresh a TikTok for Business MCP access token
seo_description: Use this endpoint to exchange a valid TikTok for Business MCP refresh token for a new access token.
